description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W", Tallgeese driven by Zechs Marquis appears in real grade in TV anime color.

description.ja: 白と黒を基調としたテレビアニメ登場時のカラーリングを成形色で再現。

description.en: The coloring based on white and black when it appeared in the TV anime "Mobile Suit Gundam W" is reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: 頭部や胸元、バックパックをはじめとした細かな色分けをパーツ分割により再現。
description.en: The detailed color coding of the head, chest, backpack, etc. is reproduced by dividing the parts.

description.ja: ●　ＲＧ特有の可動ギミックで大胆なアクションポーズが可能
description.en: ● Bold action poses are possible with the unique movable gimmick of RG.

description.ja: また、特徴的な「スーパーバーニア」は、内部構造やディテールをＲＧオリジナルギミックとして実現。
description.en: In addition, the characteristic "Super Vernier" has been realized as an RG original gimmick with internal structure and details.

description.ja: ●　ドーバーガンやシールドなどの特徴的な武装をＲＧ準拠のディテールとギミックで再現
description.en: ● Characteristic weapons such as the Dover gun and Seal are reproduced with RG-compliant details and gimmicks.

description.ja: ●　ゼクス・マーキスのパーソナルマーク等を収録した、マーキングシールとリアリスティックデカールが付属。
description.en: ● Includes MarkingSeal and realistic decals that include Zechs Marquis's personal marks.
